desc: Starting at just 5.7 lbs the Mark V High Country was purpose-built to be a lightweight, versatile mountain rifle. It features Peak 44s Bastion carbon fiber stock which weighs only 24oz. The Bastion has a shooter-friendly vertical grip and features dual front swivel studs for multiple attachments. Equipped with an Accubrake and 3DHEX Recoil pad, the High Country manages recoil extremely well, even with Weatherby’s historic magnum cartridges. This is the rifle you want when hiking to the furthest depths of the high country.
